plan.summary: Redesign and verify the bgr_core cell as a functional Brokaw bandgap reference. No layout or documentation steps are included in this phase.

phases.goal: design the circuit: write or import the cell netlist(s), simulate them at every supply, and run the PVT check (and the SEU check for storage cells). Do NOT plan any layout.

Run PVT check for bgr_core at all corners and temperatures.
